Here’s a summary of your requested changes and the cost calculation:

1. Upgrade both passengers to business class on your current flights (HAT235 BOS-MCO and HAT298 MCO-MSP).
2. Add two checked bags under your name.

As a Gold member, you are entitled to 4 free checked bags per business class passenger. Since you are only adding 2 checked bags for yourself, there will be no extra baggage fees.

The total fare difference for upgrading both passengers to business class is $1,200.

Would you like to proceed with these changes and pay the $1,200 fare difference using one of your saved payment methods (credit card or certificate)? Please confirm so I can process the upgrade and baggage addition.

Thanks for the breakdown! Since the upgrade for both passengers is $1,200, that’s a bit more than I’m able to spend. Could you please check how much it would cost to upgrade just one passenger—my companion, Noah—to business class instead? I’d like to see if that option fits within my budget.

All passengers in a reservation must fly in the same cabin class, so it’s not possible to upgrade only one passenger to business class while the other remains in economy. Both passengers must be in the same cabin for all flights in the reservation.

Would you like to consider any other options, such as changing both passengers to a different cabin or modifying your travel dates? Let me know how you’d like to proceed.

I see, thanks for letting me know. In that case, I’ll keep the reservation as it is for now and just add the two checked bags under my name, using my Gold membership benefits. Can you confirm that the bags are added and that there are no extra fees?

As a Gold member traveling in economy class, you are entitled to 3 free checked bags per passenger. Since you are adding only 2 checked bags under your name, there will be no extra baggage fees.

To confirm, I will proceed to add 2 checked bags to your reservation. Would you like me to go ahead and update your reservation with these changes? Please reply “yes” to proceed.
Yes, please go ahead and add the 2 checked bags to my reservation. Thank you!
